Audit Sprint 2 of InkOS at `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS`. Sprint 2 delivered: booking engine migration (8 tables, 6 public RPCs including `public_create_booking`), calendar (FullCalendar React), appointments list + detail, new-appointment drawer, waitlist, booking page settings, public booking flow at `/book/[studioSlug]/*`, .ics invite download, photo gallery stub.

All gates green. Audit for:
1. **Multi-tenant boundary** — every authed API route (`app/api/bookings`, `/api/artists`, `/api/services`, `/api/clients/search`, `/api/waitlist`, `/api/booking-page-settings`, `/api/bookings/[id]/photos`, `/api/upload/*`) derives `studio_id` from session via `getAuthenticatedUser()`, never from request body/query.
2. **Public RPC safety** — `app/api/public/*` routes correctly use anon client from `lib/supabase/public.ts`. Rate limits via `publicBookingRatelimit` applied. `public_create_booking` error-key check (HTTP 200 + `{error}`) handled.
3. **RLS preflight** — every new table in `20260415000004_booking_engine.sql` has RLS enabled + at least one policy. Verify `service_artists` junction table protected via `user_owns_service_studio()` helper.
4. **`EXCLUDE USING gist`** double-booking — verify `23P01` error code handled everywhere a booking insert/update can trigger it (API routes + public RPC).
5. **Booking token safety** — `booking_id` never exposed in public URLs; only `booking_token`. Grep `app/book/` and public API routes.
6. **Storage RLS** — uploads to `design-assets` + `studio-assets` use folder-prefix pattern matching Sprint 1 Mi5 fix.
7. **Zero `any`, zero `console.log`, zero raw hex outside brand swatch, zero `asChild` on base-nova, no `@supabase/auth-helpers-nextjs`** — standard sweep.
8. **Money in cents** — grep for float division/math errors in price/deposit/tip handling.
9. **`end_at` GENERATED column** — never in INSERT/UPDATE payloads.
10. **Next 16 params await** — all dynamic routes await `params: Promise<{...}>`.

Write verdict + findings to `.handoffs/sprint-2-sage-audit.md`. PASS / CONDITIONAL / BLOCK. Critical findings must be fixed before Sprint 3. Major findings should be fixed; minor to backlog. Be strict on tenant boundary + public RPC + RLS.

423	-- =============================================================
424	-- EXCLUDE USING gist: Artist double-booking prevention
425	--
426	-- This constraint prevents two active bookings for the same artist
427	-- from having overlapping time ranges at the DATABASE level.
428	--
429	-- How it works:
430	--   - tstzrange(scheduled_at, end_at, '[)') builds a half-open range:
431	--     starts at scheduled_at, ends just before end_at.
432	--   - '[)' = inclusive start, exclusive end — so back-to-back bookings
433	--     that touch (A ends at T, B starts at T) are NOT considered overlapping.
434	--   - The WITH && operator means "overlaps".
435	--   - btree_gist lets us mix a scalar uuid column with a range column
436	--     inside a single GiST index.
437	--   - WHERE clause: only fires for active statuses. Cancelled / completed /
438	--     no_show bookings do NOT block new bookings in that slot.
439	--
440	-- What it prevents:
441	--   Artist is booked 2pm-4pm (confirmed). A second INSERT with
442	--   artist_id=same, scheduled_at=3pm will FAIL immediately with a
443	--   constraint violation — no application-layer race condition possible.
444	--
445	-- When it fires:
446	--   INSERT and UPDATE on bookings where status IN ('pending','confirmed','in_progress').
447	--   Changing status to 'cancelled' releases the slot automatically.
448	-- =============================================================
449	
450	ALTER TABLE public.bookings
451	  ADD CONSTRAINT bookings_artist_no_overlap
452	  EXCLUDE USING gist (
453	    artist_id WITH =,
454	    tstzrange(scheduled_at, end_at, '[)') WITH &&
455	  )
456	  WHERE (status IN ('pending', 'confirmed', 'in_progress'));

491	-- =============================================================
492	
493	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_client_stats()
494	RETURNS TRIGGER
495	LANGUAGE plpgsql
496	SECURITY DEFINER
497	SET search_path = public
498	AS $$
499	BEGIN
500	  -- Fire only when status transitions TO 'completed'
501	  IF NEW.status = 'completed' AND (OLD.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'completed') THEN
502	    UPDATE public.clients
503	       SET total_sessions    = total_sessions + 1,
504	           total_spent_cents = total_spent_cents + NEW.price_cents + NEW.tip_cents,
505	           last_visit_at     = GREATEST(last_visit_at, NEW.scheduled_at),
506	           updated_at        = now()
507	     WHERE id = NEW.client_id;
508	  END IF;
509	
510	  -- Also reverse if status moves OUT of completed (correction scenario)
511	  IF OLD.status = 'completed' AND NEW.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'completed' THEN
512	    UPDATE public.clients
513	       SET total_sessions    = GREATEST(0, total_sessions - 1),
514	           total_spent_cents = GREATEST(0, total_spent_cents - OLD.price_cents - OLD.tip_cents),
515	           updated_at        = now()
516	     WHERE id = NEW.client_id;
517	    -- Note: last_visit_at is not reversed — computing the true max would require a subquery;
518	    -- accept minor inaccuracy here, correctable via periodic recalc job (Sprint 7).
519	  END IF;
520	
521	  RETURN NEW;
522	END;
523	$$;

526	  AFTER UPDATE ON public.bookings
527	  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.update_client_stats();

794	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.public_get_availability(
795	  p_artist_id  uuid,
796	  p_service_id uuid,
797	  p_date       date
798	)
799	RETURNS jsonb

800	LANGUAGE plpgsql
801	SECURITY DEFINER
802	STABLE
803	SET search_path = public
804	AS $$
805	DECLARE
806	  v_duration_min  INT;
807	  v_studio_tz     TEXT;
808	  v_artist_studio UUID;
809	  v_slots         jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
810	  v_slot_start    TIMESTAMPTZ;
811	  v_slot_end      TIMESTAMPTZ;
812	  v_day_start     TIMESTAMPTZ;
813	  v_day_end       TIMESTAMPTZ;
814	BEGIN
815	  -- Resolve artist studio and timezone
816	  SELECT a.studio_id, s.timezone
817	    INTO v_artist_studio, v_studio_tz
818	    FROM public.artists a
819	    JOIN public.studios s ON s.id = a.studio_id
820	   WHERE a.id = p_artist_id
821	     AND a.status = 'active';
822	
823	  IF v_artist_studio IS NULL THEN
824	    RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'artist_not_found');
825	  END IF;
826	
827	  -- Resolve service duration (use service base duration; override handled client-side)
828	  IF p_service_id IS NOT NULL THEN
829	    SELECT duration_min INTO v_duration_min
830	      FROM public.services
831	     WHERE id = p_service_id AND studio_id = v_artist_studio;
832	  END IF;
833	
834	  -- Default to 60-min slots if service not found or not provided
835	  IF v_duration_min IS NULL OR v_duration_min <= 0 THEN
836	    v_duration_min := 60;
837	  END IF;
838	
839	  -- Day window in studio timezone: 09:00 – 21:00
840	  v_day_start := (p_date || ' 09:00:00')::timestamp AT TIME ZONE v_studio_tz;
841	  v_day_end   := (p_date || ' 21:00:00')::timestamp AT TIME ZONE v_studio_tz;
842	
843	  -- Walk forward in duration-sized steps, skip slots with active bookings
844	  v_slot_start := v_day_start;
845	  WHILE v_slot_start + (v_duration_min || ' minutes')::interval <= v_day_end LOOP
846	    v_slot_end := v_slot_start + (v_duration_min || ' minutes')::interval;
847	
848	    -- Check if this slot overlaps any active booking
849	    IF NOT EXISTS (
850	      SELECT 1
851	        FROM public.bookings b
852	       WHERE b.artist_id = p_artist_id
853	         AND b.status IN ('pending', 'confirmed', 'in_progress')
854	         AND tstzrange(b.scheduled_at, b.end_at, '[)') &&
855	             tstzrange(v_slot_start, v_slot_end, '[)')
856	    ) THEN
857	      v_slots := v_slots || jsonb_build_array(
858	        jsonb_build_object(
859	          'start', v_slot_start,
860	          'end',   v_slot_end
861	        )
862	      );
863	    END IF;
864	
865	    v_slot_start := v_slot_start + (v_duration_min || ' minutes')::interval;
866	  END LOOP;
867	
868	  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
869	    'date',         p_date,
870	    'artist_id',    p_artist_id,
871	    'duration_min', v_duration_min,
872	    'slots',        v_slots
873	  );
874	END;
875	$$;
876	
877	-- 5. public_create_booking
878	--    Creates (or reuses) a client record by email, then inserts a booking.
879	--    Race-safe: the EXCLUDE USING gist constraint on bookings fires here too.
880	--    Returns booking_token on success or error details on failure.
881	
882	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.public_create_booking(
883	  p_token       uuid,        -- idempotency token supplied by client UI
884	  p_studio_slug text,
885	  p_service_id  uuid,
886	  p_artist_id   uuid,
887	  p_scheduled_at timestamptz,
888	  p_client_data  jsonb       -- {first_name, last_name, email, phone}
889	)
890	RETURNS jsonb
891	LANGUAGE plpgsql
892	SECURITY DEFINER
893	VOLATILE
894	SET search_path = public
895	AS $$
896	DECLARE
897	  v_studio_id   UUID;
898	  v_client_id   UUID;
899	  v_duration    INT;
900	  v_booking_id  UUID;
901	  v_token       UUID;
902	  v_deposit     INT;
903	BEGIN
904	  -- Resolve studio
905	  SELECT id INTO v_studio_id
906	    FROM public.studios
907	   WHERE slug = p_studio_slug;
908	
909	  IF v_studio_id IS NULL THEN
910	    RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'studio_not_found');
911	  END IF;
912	
913	  -- Validate artist belongs to studio
914	  IF NOT EXISTS (
915	    SELECT 1 FROM public.artists
916	     WHERE id = p_artist_id AND studio_id = v_studio_id AND status = 'active'
917	  ) THEN
918	    RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'artist_not_available');
919	  END IF;
920	
921	  -- Validate service belongs to studio and is public
922	  IF p_service_id IS NOT NULL THEN
923	    SELECT duration_min, deposit_cents
924	      INTO v_duration, v_deposit
925	      FROM public.services
926	     WHERE id = p_service_id AND studio_id = v_studio_id AND is_public = true;
927	
928	    IF v_duration IS NULL THEN
929	      RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'service_not_available');
930	    END IF;
931	  ELSE
932	    v_duration := 60;
933	    v_deposit  := 0;
934	  END IF;
935	
936	  -- Upsert client by email (case-insensitive) within studio
937	  IF p_client_data->>'email' IS NOT NULL AND trim(p_client_data->>'email') != '' THEN
938	    -- Try to find existing client
939	    SELECT id INTO v_client_id
940	      FROM public.clients
941	     WHERE studio_id = v_studio_id
942	       AND lower(email) = lower(trim(p_client_data->>'email'));
943	
944	    IF v_client_id IS NULL THEN
945	      INSERT INTO public.clients (
946	        studio_id, first_name, last_name, email, phone, source
947	      )
948	      VALUES (
949	        v_studio_id,
950	        coalesce(trim(p_client_data->>'first_name'), 'Guest'),
951	        nullif(trim(p_client_data->>'last_name'), ''),
952	        lower(trim(p_client_data->>'email')),
953	        nullif(trim(p_client_data->>'phone'), ''),
954	        'public'
955	      )
956	      RETURNING id INTO v_client_id;
957	    END IF;
958	  ELSE
959	    -- No email — create anonymous client record
960	    INSERT INTO public.clients (
961	      studio_id, first_name, last_name, phone, source
962	    )
963	    VALUES (
964	      v_studio_id,
965	      coalesce(trim(p_client_data->>'first_name'), 'Guest'),
966	      nullif(trim(p_client_data->>'last_name'), ''),
967	      nullif(trim(p_client_data->>'phone'), ''),
968	      'public'
969	    )
970	    RETURNING id INTO v_client_id;
971	  END IF;
972	
973	  -- Use provided token as booking_token (idempotency: if same token exists, return it)
974	  IF p_token IS NOT NULL THEN
975	    SELECT id, booking_token INTO v_booking_id, v_token
976	      FROM public.bookings
977	     WHERE booking_token = p_token;
978	
979	    IF v_booking_id IS NOT NULL THEN
980	      RETURN jsonb_build_object(
981	        'booking_id',    v_booking_id,
982	        'booking_token', v_token,
983	        'status',        'existing'
984	      );
985	    END IF;
986	  END IF;
987	
988	  -- Insert booking — EXCLUDE USING gist will reject overlaps automatically
989	  BEGIN
990	    INSERT INTO public.bookings (
991	      studio_id,
992	      client_id,
993	      artist_id,
994	      service_id,
995	      scheduled_at,
996	      duration_min,
997	      status,
998	      deposit_cents,
999	      source,
1000	      booking_token
1001	    )
1002	    VALUES (
1003	      v_studio_id,
1004	      v_client_id,
1005	      p_artist_id,
1006	      p_service_id,
1007	      p_scheduled_at,
1008	      v_duration,
1009	      'pending',
1010	      coalesce(v_deposit, 0),
1011	      'public',
1012	      coalesce(p_token, gen_random_uuid())
1013	    )
1014	    RETURNING id, booking_token INTO v_booking_id, v_token;
1015	  EXCEPTION
1016	    WHEN exclusion_violation THEN
1017	      RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'time_slot_unavailable');
1018	    WHEN OTHERS THEN
1019	      RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', SQLERRM);
1020	  END;
1021	
1022	  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
1023	    'booking_id',    v_booking_id,
1024	    'booking_token', v_token,
1025	    'status',        'created'
1026	  );
1027	END;
1028	$$;
1029	
1030	-- 6. public_get_booking_by_token
1031	--    Returns denormalized booking data for the confirmation page.
1032	--    Authenticated only by possession of the token — no login required.
1033	
1034	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.public_get_booking_by_token(p_token uuid)
1035	RETURNS jsonb
1036	LANGUAGE sql
1037	SECURITY DEFINER
1038	STABLE
1039	SET search_path = public
1040	AS $$
1041	  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
1042	    'booking_id',    b.id,
1043	    'booking_token', b.booking_token,
1044	    'status',        b.status,
1045	    'scheduled_at',  b.scheduled_at,
1046	    'end_at',        b.end_at,
1047	    'duration_min',  b.duration_min,
1048	    'price_cents',   b.price_cents,
1049	    'deposit_cents', b.deposit_cents,
1050	    'deposit_paid',  b.deposit_paid,
1051	    'source',        b.source,
1052	    'client_notes',  b.client_notes,
1053	    'studio', jsonb_build_object(
1054	      'name',       s.name,
1055	      'slug',       s.slug,
1056	      'logo_url',   s.logo_url,
1057	      'timezone',   s.timezone
1058	    ),
1059	    'artist', jsonb_build_object(
1060	      'display_name', a.display_name,
1061	      'avatar_url',   a.avatar_url
1062	    ),
1063	    'service', CASE WHEN sv.id IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_object(
1064	      'name',         sv.name,
1065	      'duration_min', sv.duration_min
1066	    ) ELSE NULL END,
1067	    'client', jsonb_build_object(
1068	      'first_name', c.first_name,
1069	      'last_name',  c.last_name,
1070	      'email',      c.email
1071	    )
1072	  )
1073	  FROM public.bookings b
1074	  JOIN public.studios  s  ON s.id = b.studio_id
1075	  JOIN public.artists  a  ON a.id = b.artist_id
1076	  JOIN public.clients  c  ON c.id = b.client_id
1077	  LEFT JOIN public.services sv ON sv.id = b.service_id
1078	  WHERE b.booking_token = p_token
1079	  LIMIT 1;
1080	$$;
1081	
1082	-- =============================================================
1083	-- GRANT EXECUTE on public RPC functions to anon role ONLY
1084	-- Authenticated users go through authenticated Supabase client.

1086

1088	GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.public_get_services_for_studio(uuid)     TO anon;
